title: Feeling Hopeless? Read This
subtitle: Two ayahs from Surah At-Talaq for hard days

content.text: Some days nothing seems to work. The bills, the family, the job, the news. If that is where you are today, Allah has two ayahs for you in Surah At-Talaq (65:2–3):
In the Qur'an:

content.alt: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا ۝ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا (Qur'an 65:2–3)

content.text: "Whoever is mindful of Allah, He will make a way out for him, and provide for him from where he never expected. Whoever puts his trust in Allah, He is enough for him. Allah always carries out what He decides. Allah has set a measure for everything."
Three promises
A way out:
مَخْرَجًا (
makhraj
), literally "a place of exit". The door may be one you cannot see yet.
Provision you did not count on:
مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ "from where he does not reckon". You plan from what you can see; Allah provides from what you cannot.
Enough:
فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ "He is enough for him". The word حَسْب is the same one we say in حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ "Allah is enough for us".
And one condition

Each promise begins with a condition: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ "whoever is mindful of Allah" and وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ "whoever puts his trust in Allah". Trust is not sitting still. It is doing your part honestly and leaving the result to Him.

The last line is a comfort too: قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا "Allah has set a measure for everything." Your difficulty also has a measure. It will not last one day longer than Allah has set.
